notes.subject: je
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a copula; the predication is juxtapositional: Jahve — my shepherd.

notes.subject: ničesar
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb אחסר 'lack/want' is absolute; Slovene needs an object or adverbial to read naturally.

notes.subject: pesem
notes.rationale: מזמור properly denotes instrumental music, a poem set to notes.

notes.subject: molivec
notes.rationale: First-person declaration of trust; the speaker addresses no one but speaks of Jahve.

translation: Pesem Davidu. Jahve ⟨je⟩ moj pastir, ne bom pogrešal ⟨ničesar⟩.
